article_title: Tech stocks are now cheaper than the S&P 500 for the first time since 2017 — here’s what history says comes next: Chart of the Day
author: Jared Blikre
title: After 4 straight losing weeks, the S&P 500 has usually done better than normal
subtitle: Median S&P 500 return, since 1990
source_credit: Yahoo Finance calculations. 33 streaks of four or more weekly losses since 1990.
metric: Median subsequent S&P 500 return after losing streaks, compared with median subsequent return after any week. NOT a valuation-discount study.
qualifiers: Dot-com bust and 2008 financial crisis were exceptions discussed in the article.
No inference that a 17x technology forward P/E produces these returns.
